title: 射击

content_zh:
连胜用大为吃惊的语气说：“你这就走了？”
赵卓荦迟疑的停下脚步：“怎么？”
连胜看向伤员说：“没什么。只是我以为, 打伤别人起码会尽到最基本的道德看护。”
赵卓荦：“……”
赵卓荦犹豫片刻, 似乎在思考她的话。随后在旁边坐了下来, 真的干起看护工作。
林医生有些诧异地看向他, 但是没有出声。
连胜搬了椅子, 坐到他旁边，问道：“什么是积分赛？”
“……就是拿积分。”赵卓荦说，“指挥系每天至少一场, 其余专业每天两场。单兵系每天四场。”
连胜：“你……？”
“单兵作战系，和你同级生。”医生插话说，“明星学员了。往年拿过两次积分第一。”
连胜点头：“厉害。”
赵卓荦轻瞥她一眼, 略带茫然。这人是谁？
连胜又问：“积分有什么用？”
赵卓荦斟酌了一下, 解释说：“积分就是功绩。平时训练也会有教官打分，最后一天实战的时候用。”
连胜：“什么实战？”
“红白阵营战。”赵卓荦顿了顿, “就是打群架。”
连胜：“分配职务用？”
赵卓荦：“嗯。”
连胜点头, 原来如此。
他们指挥系, 四个年级加起来有一百多人, 但是, 总指挥只会有一个。

不管在哪里都是一样, 最后还得看实力。
这么说来，积分的确挺有意思的。
医生坐在旁边敲着光脑，提醒道：“你已经休息够了吧, 喝杯水可以回去了。我这里不接受难民。”
连胜四肢还是有些酸软, 但是已经缓过劲来了。她站起来抖了抖，对那位朋友说：“我要走了，你还留这里吗？”
赵卓荦一脸冷漠道：“尽基本道德看护。”
连胜：“公平对决的话，有什么道德看护义务？战场上的敌军死了还需要看护他全家？还要养一个军？”
赵卓荦：“……”
赵卓荦眼神里几乎要喷出火来。那特么不是她刚刚自己说的吗？！
“我刚刚就是随口一说。”连胜点头评论道，“你是个好人。”
赵卓荦：“……”
连胜：“现在我话问完了，你可以走了。”
赵卓荦：“……”
去她的！这人简直莫名其妙！
赵卓荦站起来，直接拉开门出去。
床上那人抬起手和他们摇了摇。医生看向他赶人道：“半小时后你也可以走了。”
病号：“……”
连胜重新加入训练的阵营，继续绕着山道跑步。
开始的过程总是痛苦。连胜体能薄弱，直接从越野跑进行锻炼，身体负担太大。只能断断续续，再艰难前进。
付教官吃够教训，没再勉强她。基本布置完任务，就让她一个人慢慢追。
但是他发现自己每次停下来，都能看见连胜跟在后面。她虽然慢，可根据她的速度，能知道这人没有偷懒。再联想她之前测试出来的体能。在没人督促的情况下，还能一直走在极限的边缘。

这人的毅力非常可怕。
中午训练到四点，吃晚饭，一小时休息时间，然后再继续。
连胜虚脱后没什么食欲，只感受到反胃。还是用水伴着米饭，多吃了一碗。
一直到晚上八点，连胜落后同队成员平均三圈的路程。众人站在原地，等她归队。
前面的人有些不耐烦，在远处催促着她。
连胜抹了把脸，加入队列。
付教官吹起口哨，终于道：“解散！”
连胜沉沉叹了口气，正想坐下好好休息片刻，就见所有人以百米冲刺的速度直窜而出。快似闪电，迅如疾风，全然没有之前那种半死不活的萎顿气质。
连胜遥遥往下一望，人已经都不见了。
连胜看向付教官，惊道：“还有宵夜呢？”
“……”付教官斜她一眼，“你做梦呢？”
等连胜慢悠悠甩着帽子下山，才知道这群人如此疯狂的原因。
洗澡的地方，排出有百米长队。连胜捧着自己的脸盆站在队伍的末端，陷入深深的沉思。
等她终于洗完，已经差不多将近午夜了。
她回到自己的行李附近，将脸盆放下，摸了摸头，围着散落的帐篷组件走了一圈。
旁边有几位学生也刚回来，轻手轻脚地在整理床铺。看她站着发呆，还想过来问问要不要帮忙。
就见这位传奇的女子，干脆地抖起帐篷外面的粗布，将自己整个包了起来。然后直接往床垫上一躺，用衣服盖住眼睛，转了个身准备睡觉。

content_en:
Lian Sheng said in a shocked tone: "Are you leaving now?"
Zhao Zhuorun stopped hesitantly: "What?"
Lian Sheng looked at the injured person and said, "It's nothing. It's just that I thought that when I hurt others, I would at least take care of the most basic moral principles."
Zhao Zhuorun: "..."
Zhao Zhuorun hesitated for a moment, seeming to be thinking about her words. Then I sat down next to him and really started to do the care work.
Dr. Lin looked at him in surprise, but said nothing.
Lian Sheng moved a chair, sat next to him, and asked, "What is a points match?"
"...just to get points." Zhao Zhuorun said, "At least one game a day for the command system, two games a day for the other majors. Four games a day for the individual soldier system."
Lian Sheng: "You...?"
"In the individual combat department, I am a student of the same level as you." The doctor interrupted, "He is a star student. He has won the first place in points twice in the past years."
Lian Sheng nodded: "Awesome."
Zhao Zhuorun glanced at her, slightly confused. Who is this person?
Lian Sheng asked again: "What are the points for?"
Zhao Zhuorun thought for a while and explained: "Points are merit. Instructors will also give points during normal training, and they will be used in actual combat on the last day."
Streak: "What actual combat?"
"The battle between the red and white camps." Zhao Zhuorun paused, "It's just a group fight."
Lian Sheng: "For assigning duties?"
Zhao Zhuorun: "Yeah."
Streak nodded, that's it.
Their command department, with four grades combined, has more than a hundred people, but there will only be one commander-in-chief.
No matter where you are, it's the same. In the end, it all depends on your strength.
That being said, points are indeed quite interesting.
The doctor was sitting next to him, knocking on his brain, and reminded him: "You've had enough rest, drink a glass of water and you can go back. I don't accept refugees here."
Lian Sheng's limbs are still a little sore, but he has recovered. She stood up, shook her head, and said to her friend, "I'm leaving, will you stay here?"
Zhao Zhuorun said with an indifferent expression: "Exercise basic moral care."
Lian Sheng: "In a fair fight, what moral duty of care is there? If an enemy soldier dies on the battlefield, do you still need to take care of his whole family? Do you need to support an army?"
Zhao Zhuorun: "..."
Zhao Zhuorun's eyes almost burst out with fire. Wasn't that what she just said herself? !
"I just said it casually." Lian Sheng nodded and commented, "You are a good person."
Zhao Zhuorun: "..."
Lian Sheng: "Now that I've finished my questions, you can leave."
Zhao Zhuorun: "..."
Fuck it! This man is simply incomprehensible!
Zhao Zhuorun stood up, opened the door and went out.
The man on the bed raised his hand and shook it with them. The doctor looked at him and said, "You can leave in half an hour."
Patient number: "..."
Lian Sheng rejoined the training camp and continued running around the mountain trail.
The process is always painful to begin with. Lian Sheng's physical fitness is weak, so training directly from cross-country running is too much of a physical burden. We can only move forward intermittently and with difficulty.
Instructor Fu had learned enough lessons and didn't force her anymore. After basically assigning the task, let her chase slowly by herself.
But he found that every time he stopped, he could see Streak following behind. Although she was slow, based on her speed, she could tell that this person was not slacking off. Then think about her physical ability that she tested before. You can always walk on the edge of your limits without anyone supervising you.
This man's perseverance is terrifying.
Train until four o'clock at noon, have dinner, rest for an hour, and then continue again.
After the collapse, I had no appetite and only felt nauseated. I still drank water with the rice and ate one more bowl.
Until 8pm, Streak was an average of three laps behind his teammates. Everyone stood there, waiting for her to return.
The person in front was a little impatient and urged her from a distance.
Lian Sheng wiped his face and joined the queue.
Instructor Fu whistled and finally said: "Disband!"
Winning streak sinksShen sighed and was about to sit down and rest for a while when he saw everyone sprinting out at a sprint speed of 100 meters. As fast as lightning, as fast as the wind, without the half-dead and languid temperament before.
Lian Sheng looked down from a distance and saw that everyone was gone.
Lian Sheng looked at Instructor Fu and said in surprise: "Is there any late night snack?"
"..." Instructor Fu glanced at her, "Are you dreaming?"
Only when Lian Sheng slowly walked down the mountain, swinging his hat, did he realize why these people were so crazy.
There was a queue of 100 meters long at the bathing area. Lian Sheng stood at the end of the team holding his own washbasin and fell into deep contemplation.
By the time she finally finished washing, it was almost midnight.
She returned to her luggage, put down the basin, touched her head, and walked around the scattered tent components.
There were several students nearby who had just come back and were quietly making the beds. Seeing her standing in a daze, I wanted to come over and ask if she wanted to help.
Seeing this legendary woman, she simply shook up the coarse cloth outside the tent and wrapped herself up. Then he lay down directly on the mattress, covered his eyes with clothes, and turned around to get ready for sleep.
